shared_elements: bird-like creature in profile with prominent curved beak
large round eye rendered as a circle/disc
multiple creature figures covering a rock surface in low relief
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic low-relief creatures dominated by profile beaked bird-heads with large circular eyes, plus rounded spiral/disc motifs, rendered as smooth-surfaced outlined silhouettes rather than naturalistic bodies. However, B organises its animals into stacked horizontal registers separated by a band of geometric zigzag/chevron ornament with distinct snakes, quadrupeds and arm-like elements, while A is an unregistered, overlapping jumble of repeated composite bird-headed figures with no banding or comparable figural inventory.
